certs.title: Java EE 7 Application Developer

certs.title: MySQL 8.0 Database Administrator
certs.desc: Sertifikasi OCP untuk DBA MySQL 8.0: arsitektur InnoDB, instalasi, security, monitoring, optimasi query, backup, dan replikasi sampai InnoDB Cluster.

roadmap.goal: Architecture: koneksi, datadir, InnoDB, buffer pool, data dictionary.
Installation: paket, file, start/stop, upgrade, option file, variabel, multi-instance.
Security (domain terbesar): user, role, plugin auth, TLS, password, enkripsi, firewall.
Monitoring: log, status, audit, kapasitas, lock dan deadlock.
Query Optimization: EXPLAIN, index, statistik, performance_schema.
Backup: jenis, strategi, MEB, mysqldump, raw file, binlog + PITR.
HA: replikasi, multisource, thread, troubleshooting, InnoDB Cluster dan recovery.

topics.title: Cara InnoDB menyimpan data dan log
Menjalankan beberapa server di satu host
Backup dan restore dengan Enterprise Backup
Backup logis dengan mysqldump dan mysqlpump
Backup binary log dan point-in-time recovery

certs.title: MySQL 8.0 Database Developer
certs.desc: Sertifikasi OCP untuk developer MySQL 8.0: konektor dan API, aplikasi berbasis data, objek skema, transaksi, optimasi, stored programs, serta JSON dan document store.

roadmap.goal: Connectors and APIs: pilih konektor, pooling, ambil data, nilai khusus, kredensial.
Data-driven Applications: prepared statement, SQL mode, error/warning, agregasi, laporan.
Schema objects: view, tipe string, numerik, temporal, spasial.
Transactions: SQL, aplikasi, isolation level, locking.
Query Optimization: index, EXPLAIN, rewrite query.
Stored Programs: routine, konstruksi, trigger, event scheduler.
JSON dan document store: JSON_TABLE, X DevAPI, MySQL Shell.
Ujian latihan penuh, ulangi domain dengan skor terendah.

topics.title: Mengatur SQL Mode untuk mengubah perilaku
Mengakses document store dengan MySQL Shell

certs.title: MySQL Implementation Associate

certs.title: Oracle Database SQL

roadmap.goal: Konsep relasional, SELECT, alias, NULL, filter, dan sorting.
Fungsi satu baris dan konversi: string, tanggal, angka, NVL, TO_CHAR.
Agregasi (GROUP BY/HAVING) lalu join lengkap termasuk outer dan kartesian.

DDL: tabel, kolom, constraint, temporary dan external table, index/synonym/sequence.
